name: House Box Wooden Desk Calendar With Storage
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material: 
    This desk calendar is crafted from high-quality wood, featuring two thickness levels for enhanced durability and structure:
    - 5 mm wooden panels for the main house frame.
    - 2 mm wooden panels for the calendar sheets and supporting parts.
    The wooden surface is smooth, sturdy, and designed to maintain its shape and vibrant prints over time.

 

  • Sizes and Dimensions: 
    House Box (assembled):  5.5  x  6.5  x 8  inches ~ 13.97 x  16.51  x  20.32 cm
    - Roof panel (WxH): 4.5 x 6.5 inches ~ 11.43 x 16.51 cm
    - Calendar Panels: 6 pcs included Size: 4 × 6 inches ~ 10.16 × 15.24 cm
    - 3 x Metal Ring Binder diameter: 1.38 in ~ 3.5 cm
    All pieces interlock securely for a neat and sturdy final structure.
    📌 Easy Assembly: Requires simple self-assembly by interlocking the pre-cut wood pieces—no tools or glue needed.

 

  • Printing Technology:
    - Printed using advanced UV printing technology, ensuring vibrant colors, sharp details, and a glossy, fade-resistant finish.
    - The product is printed on both sides, offering a polished, professional look from every angle.

 

  • Functional & Usage:
    This unique house-shaped wooden box functions as both a desk calendar and a small storage organizer. It is ideal for:
    - Displaying monthly calendars in a cute, decorative format
    - Storing small items such as keys, notes, pens, mementos, or desk accessories
    - Adding charm to your workspace, living room, bedside table, or office desk
    - Easy to assemble and lightweight, making it convenient to move or gift
    The roof acts as the display area for the calendar sheets, while the interior space can be used for storage.

 

  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion: 
    - This House Box Wooden Desk Calendar makes a thoughtful and stylish gift for: Housewarming, Christmas, Birthdays, Anniversaries, New Year, Mother’s Day, Father’s Day, Office celebrations, Teachers, coworkers, friends, or family, etc.
    - Its blend of practical use and charming design makes it suitable for anyone and for any special occasion.

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 1 – 3 working days on average after payment and all designs updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1 x House Box Wooden Desk Calendar With Storage

 

PRODUCTION

  • Manufacturer: Made by Printway
  • The tracking Country Origin is the US

Print Guidelines

Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
